moon.metric_family_interpretation: Agreement between two descriptor families from the same GLO-90 DEM. This is robustness analysis, not independent-data validation.

mars.metric_family_interpretation: Agreement between two descriptor families from the same GLO-90 DEM. This is robustness analysis, not independent-data validation.

interpretation: Metric-family robustness checks the consistency of alternative terrain descriptors from the same DEM. It is not an independent validation set, probability, calibrated accuracy or expert/field truth.

global_land_cover_enrichment.interpretation: Global land-cover class fractions for retained terrain shortlist windows only; not a geological, mineralogical or field-validation result.

scope.coverage_note: Enrichment is limited to the retained top-100-per-target terrain shortlist, deduplicated by candidate window ID; it is not a global climate raster or all-window climate scan.

global_nasa_power_climatology.interpretation: NASA POWER climatology context for retained global shortlist candidates only; gridded climatology, not local ground observations.

independent_dem_crosscheck.source: NASADEM SRTM-derived elevation compared with Copernicus GLO-30 at selected overlapping sites
limits: NASADEM has approximate coverage from 56°S to 60°N; high-latitude sites such as McMurdo, Haughton or Iceland may be outside its coverage.
NASADEM uses SRTM with auxiliary void filling and is not a perfect independent ground survey.
NASADEM and Copernicus GLO-30 have different acquisition sensors, processing and DSM/DEM semantics; compare coarse descriptors, not absolute elevation datums.
This is independent raster-source checking, not in-situ field validation, geological validation or planetary analog validation.
Rank correlation is only descriptive for this small, selected set and must not be presented as calibrated model accuracy.

ground_truth_validation.note: No physical field observations are present in the repository. The field protocol and evidence validator do not substitute for field measurements.

release_gate.independent_source_check: report only where NASADEM actually processed and site coverage is reported
release_gate.field_validation: requires georeferenced, instrumented observations and independent review
release_gate.global_scan: must have complete tile inventory coverage and zero unreported tile failures before calling complete
